title: YC-backed personal assistant startup Pally raises $5.2 million
excerpt: Pally, an AI assistant startup, wants to help you be a better reply guy. It's raised millions to grow it product.
content_html:
Exclusive

This YC startup raised $5 million for a personal assistant to help you stay on top of your text messages

By Sydney Bradley

You're currently following this author! Want to unfollow? Unsubscribe via the link in your email.

It's hard to be a good texter these days.

Between the default texting services and inboxes galore — WhatsApp, Instagram, email, you name it — messages are bound to fall through the cracks.

Pally, a Y-Combinator startup that launched in 2025, thinks it can help people manage their texts and tasks with an AI-powered personal assistant.

"Relationships are the single most important thing in our lives," Pally cofounder Haz Hubble told Business Insider. "We want to use technology to be better at managing those relationships, rather than having technology come in and replace these relationships."

The startup has raised $5.2 million since wrapping up its YC stint last summer, Business Insider can exclusively reveal. Pally was valued at $30 million, according to the company. The funding was led by Cyber Fund and Y Combinator and included other venture capital firms such as Pioneer Fund, Founders Inc, and 468 Capital, as well as angel investors.

Pally is competing in a crowded market for AI assistants. According to YC's website, the incubator has backed over 140 startups in this category. Pally is betting on text messaging as the way to reach users and launched its latest iteration in June.

"You should go where your users are," Hubble said. "Put as little amount of friction between your product or the 'wow' moment and your user discovering it as possible."

Starting out is simple: Text the number for Pally.

Then, an AI-generated response will appear, introducing itself as Pally. The exchange is first in all lowercase, a decision on Pally's end because it "feels more human," Hubble said. Pally will adapt to the person's own style, though. If they're using Gen Z slang or shorthand, Pally will mirror that.

Pally can sync with several platforms, from email servers like Gmail and Outlook to third-party apps like Slack, the AI notetaker Granola, and Notion. Users, however, need to authorize access and can do so via the links the Pally assistant sends. To connect to Gmail, for instance, Pally uses a tool called Composio to connect the accounts. For iMessage, Pally has a separate desktop app for Macs that syncs messages.

Users also get a dashboard login on Pally's website, where they can manage access to those accounts, assign Pally tasks, manually edit contacts, or see what Pally has saved about them. Pally encrypts the information as it travels between destinations, Hubble said. The startup doesn't sell or train models on the data, either, he added.

After giving Pally access, it can book flights, maintain inboxes, respond to messages, and book restaurant reservations, Hubble said.

Under the hood, Pally uses AI platforms such as Anthropic's Claude and OpenAI's ChatGPT, and open-source models like Kimi K3 and GLM 5.2.

As a company, Pally has outsourced its engineering tasks to Claude Code, too, spending about $20,000 a month on Fable, one of Anthropic's coding models. Hubble compared the model to a "staff level engineer" working 24/7.

While Pally had previously hired staff and part-time interns, it trimmed its team to just Hubble and his cofounder, Wyatt Lansford.

With its funding, Pally plans to focus on growth and marketing, including hiring another team member, since the work requires a "human touch," Hubble said.

The AI assistant wars

Pally is one of many startups building tools to bring AI to the masses with consumer-facing products.

There are wearables, like Friend AI, pitching hardware as an AI companion that guides real people through life.

Then there's the deluge of AI personal assistants.

Town AI, for instance, raised a $55 million Series A this year from firms like A16z and Forerunner. Poke, meanwhile, another assistant that lives in text messages, was recently acquired by AI agent company Cognition. Others are building more social versions of AI personal assistants, like Series, which is building a professional networking tool that lives in text messages.

Startups like Pally are battling it out among themselves and against the bigger players. There are various assistant tools coming from larger companies like Microsoft, Meta, OpenAI, and Anthropic.

Hubble believes that as a smaller, consumer-focused company, Pally can provide a more personalized experience for users.

The AI assistant business runs primarily on users' willingness to pay. Pally has a free version and a "pro" tier that costs about $25 a month, which lets users sync more apps. Its higher tier, at $200 a month, provides an assistant with its own email address and phone number.

"People are ready to spend money on this when they never were four years ago," Hubble said.

独家的

这家 YC 初创公司筹集了 500 万美元用于私人助理，帮助您掌控短信

作者：Sydney Bradley 您目前正在关注该作者！ 想要取消关注吗？ 通过电子邮件中的链接取消订阅。

如今，成为一名优秀的发短信者很难。

在默认的短信服务和大量的收件箱（WhatsApp、Instagram、电子邮件等等）之间，消息肯定会被漏掉。

Pally 是一家于 2025 年推出的 Y-Combinator 初创公司，它认为它可以帮助人们通过人工智能驱动的个人助理管理文本和任务。

“人际关系是我们生活中最重要的事情，”Pally 联合创始人 Haz Hubble 告诉《商业内幕》。 “我们希望利用技术更好地管理这些关系，而不是让技术取代这些关系。”

Business Insider 独家透露，自去年夏天结束 YC 任期以来，这家初创公司已筹集了 520 万美元。 据该公司称，Pally 的估值为 3000 万美元。 本轮融资由 Cyber​​ Fund 和 Y Combinator 领投，其他风险投资公司包括 Pioneer Fund、Founders Inc 和 468 Capital 以及天使投资人。

Pally 正在激烈的人工智能助手市场中展开竞争。 据 YC 网站称，该孵化器已支持该类别的 140 多家初创公司。 Pally 押注于短信作为接触用户的方式，并于 6 月推出了最新版本。

“你应该去你的用户所在的地方，”哈勃说。 “在你的产品或‘哇’时刻和你的用户发现它之间尽可能减少摩擦。”

开始很简单：发短信给 Pally。

然后，人工智能生成的响应将会出现，介绍自己为 Pally。 哈勃说，这个交换首先是小写的，这是帕利最后的决定，因为它“感觉更人性化”。 不过，帕利会适应这个人自己的风格。 如果他们使用 Z 世代俚语或速记法，Pally 也会效仿。

Pally 可以与多个平台同步，从 Gmail 和 Outlook 等电子邮件服务器到 Slack、AI 记事本 Granola 和 Notion 等第三方应用程序。 然而，用户需要授权访问，并且可以通过 Pally 助手发送的链接来执行此操作。 例如，为了连接到 Gmail，Pally 使用名为 Composio 的工具来连接帐户。 对于 iMessage，Pally 有一个单独的 Mac 桌面应用程序可以同步消息。

用户还可以在 Pally 网站上登录仪表板，在那里他们可以管理对这些帐户的访问、分配 Pally 任务、手动编辑联系人或查看 Pally 保存的有关他们的内容。 哈勃说，帕利在目的地之间传输时对信息进行加密。 他补充说，这家初创公司也不销售或训练数据模型。

Hubble 表示，在授予 Pally 访问权限后，它可以预订航班、维护收件箱、回复消息以及预订餐厅。

在幕后，Pally 使用 Anthropic 的 Claude 和 OpenAI 的 ChatGPT 等人工智能平台，以及 Kimi K3 和 GLM 5.2 等开源模型。

作为一家公司，Pally 也将其工程任务外包给 Claude Code，每月在 Fable（Anthropic 的编码模型之一）上花费约 20,000 美元。 哈勃将该模型比作全天候工作的“参谋级工程师”。

虽然 Pally 此前曾雇佣过员工和兼职实习生，但该公司将团队精简为仅哈勃和他的联合创始人怀亚特·兰斯福德 (Wyatt Lansford)。

哈勃说，利用这笔资金，帕利计划专注于增长和营销，包括雇用另一名团队成员，因为这项工作需要“人情味”。

AI助手大战

Pally 是众多构建工具的初创公司之一，旨在通过面向消费者的产品将人工智能带给大众。

有一些可穿戴设备，比如 Friend AI，将硬件作为人工智能伴侣来指导人们的生活。

然后是人工智能个人助理的泛滥。

例如，Town AI 今年从 A16z 和 Forerunner 等公司筹集了 5500 万美元的 A 轮融资。 与此同时，另一位以短信为生的助手 Poke 最近被人工智能代理公司 Cognition 收购。 其他公司正在构建更多社交版本的人工智能个人助理，例如 Series，它正在构建一种存在于短信中的专业网络工具。

像 Pally 这样的初创公司正在相互竞争，并与更大的公司竞争。 Microsoft、Meta、OpenAI 和 Anthropic 等大公司提供了各种辅助工具。

Hubble 相信，作为一家规模较小、以消费者为中心的公司，Pally 可以为用户提供更加个性化的体验。

AI助手业务的运行主要取决于用户的付费意愿。 Pally 有一个免费版本和一个“专业”版本，每月费用约为 25 美元，可以让用户同步更多应用程序。 其更高级别的服务为每月 200 美元，提供一名拥有自己的电子邮件地址和电话号码的助理。

哈勃说：“四年前，人们还没有准备好为此花钱。”
